segments.name: Blood tests
segments.description: Develops and brings to market simple, cost-effective blood tests to help diagnose and monitor life-altering diseases including cancers and sepsis.
segments.evidence: Management has determined that the Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns product revenue from sales of its Nu.Q® Vet Cancer Test, nucleosomes and research use only kits, plus service revenue from laboratory work, and licensing and royalty revenue from third parties.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates product revenues from the sale of its Nu.Q ® Vet Cancer Test, from the sale of nucleosomes, and from the sale of research use only kits.
